Control.name: Options_Video_Graphics_Presets

self:SetParent(ZO_OptionsWindowSettingsScrollChild) self.data = {tooltipText = function() return "Sets the graphics settings of the selected preset." end} self:GetChild(2):SetText("Graphics Preset") self:SetHidden(false) local scrollControl = self:GetChild(1).m_comboBox.m_scroll ZO_ScrollList_Clear(scrollControl) ZO_ScrollList_Commit(scrollControl)

Control.name: Options_Video_Graphics_Presets_Editbox
Control.OnInitialized:
self:SetParent(Options_Video_Graphics_Presets:GetNamedChild("Dropdown"))
local savingEditBoxObject = ZO_SavingEditBox:New(self) self.savingEditBox = savingEditBoxObject savingEditBoxObject.edit:SetMultiLine(false) savingEditBoxObject:SetPutTextInQuotes(false) savingEditBoxObject.display:SetText("Create preset") savingEditBoxObject:SetDefaultText("Preset name") savingEditBoxObject.empty:SetHidden(false)
self:SetAnchor(TOP, Options_Video_Graphics_Presets:GetNamedChild("Dropdown"), BOTTOM) self:SetWidth(200) self:SetHeight(100) savingEditBoxObject.editBackdrop:ClearAnchors() savingEditBoxObject.editBackdrop:SetAnchor(TOPLEFT, savingEditBoxObject.control, TOPLEFT, 0, 4) savingEditBoxObject.editBackdrop:SetHeight(30) savingEditBoxObject.editBackdrop:SetWidth(198) savingEditBoxObject.edit:ClearAnchors() savingEditBoxObject.edit:SetAnchor(TOPLEFT, savingEditBoxObject.editBackdrop, TOPLEFT, 8, 3) savingEditBoxObject.edit:SetAnchor(BOTTOMRIGHT, savingEditBoxObject.editBackdrop, BOTTOMRIGHT) savingEditBoxObject.edit:SetHeight(24) savingEditBoxObject.modifyButton:ClearAnchors() savingEditBoxObject.modifyButton:SetAnchor(RIGHT, savingEditBoxObject.editBackdrop, RIGHT) savingEditBoxObject.cancelButton:ClearAnchors() savingEditBoxObject.cancelButton:SetAnchor(RIGHT, savingEditBoxObject.editBackdrop, RIGHT)
savingEditBoxObject.saveButton:SetHandler("OnClicked", function() local self = savingEditBoxObject local newText = self:GetText()
for i=1,#GP.savedVariables.presets do if string.match(newText, GP.savedVariables.presets[i].name) then ZO_Dialogs_ShowDialog("GraphicsPresetsOverwrite") return end end
self:FireCallbacks("Save", newText) self:ResetText() self:SetEditing(false) self.display:SetText("Create preset")
if string.len(newText) ~= 0 then GP.AddPreset(newText) end end)
savingEditBoxObject.edit:SetHandler("OnEnter", function() end)
savingEditBoxObject.modifyButton:SetHandler("OnMouseEnter", function() InitializeTooltip(InformationTooltip, savingEditBoxObject.modifyButton, BOTTOM, 0, -2) SetTooltipText(InformationTooltip, "New") end) savingEditBoxObject.modifyButton:SetHandler("OnMouseExit", function() ClearTooltip(InformationTooltip) end)
